notes.title: Update 1.02 — Localization Improvements & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi! This is a small but important update:

🌐 Localization Improvements
- Fixed issues with Japanese and Korean characters not displaying correctly — all symbols should now appear properly.

🐞 Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck on stairs for a few seconds.
- Also fixed some minor issues.

Thanks for your support and feedback — it means a lot to me as a solo developer.
I'll keep improving the game 👁️

notes.title: 🛠 Update 1.01 — Fixes and Improvements ❄️
🎉 Uncanny Tales: Cold Road is out now! ❄️
notes.notes:
Friends, the day has come — Uncanny Tales: Cold Road is officially released on Steam!

Thank you to everyone who added the game to their wishlist, shared it, waited, and supported me — you’re amazing!
This is my first release, and I’ve poured my heart into it. I hope you’ll feel the atmosphere and the quiet sense of dread I tried to capture.

💸 To celebrate the release, the game is 15% off — don’t miss out!
The discount will last for two weeks, so now is the perfect time to take the Cold Road.

Thank you so much for your attention and support — it means the world to me ❤️
If you’ve already played the game, please consider leaving a review — it really helps!

See you soon 🙊

notes.title: Uncanny Tales: Cold Road release on April 16 at 15:00 GMT / 08:00 PDT!

Add the game to your wishlist so you don’t miss the release! Thank you for your support! 🙌
